theme_and_archetype.description: Warm, human, dignified, editorial, unhurried. A compassion-forward brand with no AI-slop patterns.

rules: Use Cormorant Garamond (or Playfair Display) for all headings to establish an elegant, high-end editorial feel.
Use Lora for body text to maintain a warm, readable, humanist tone.
Headlines (Size > 32px): MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Copy is poetic. Use lots of short line breaks—typography and rhythm matter enormously.
Avoid generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Syne entirely.
No cold blues or purples. Do NOT use purple gradients.
Use the Soft Ivory / Cream (#F9F6F0) as the primary canvas.
Deep Forest (#2A3B2C) for text ensures high contrast while remaining earthy.
Use generous padding like py-24, py-32 for sections to give content room to breathe.
Negative space is highly valued. Do not cram elements.
Use subtle asymmetry and overlapping image/text blocks.
Always left-align dense copy for readability, but allow center-alignment for poetic, short, reverent statements.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or softly rounded (rounded-full or rounded-2xl). Avoid harsh square edges. Primary buttons in Deep Forest or Terracotta. Include a subtle ripple hover effect.
components.forms: The volunteer registration must feel like a 'virtual journey', not a plain form. Use fading transitions between steps, large typography, encouraging microcopy, and a dot-based progress indicator.
components.cards: Avoid generic card grids with borders and drop shadows. Use clean, borderless images with text neatly aligned below or to the side. Apply a subtle image zoom on hover.
components.icons: Use lucide-react for minimal, organic icons. Keep stroke width fine (1-1.25px).
components.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

motion_and_interactions.ripple_motif: Weave the 'ripple' motif visually using circular concentric waves and gentle expanding animations across the site as a visual thread.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Soft fade-ins. Unhurried reveals on scroll using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text links should have a gentle underline fade-in. Images should have a very slight, slow scale (e.g., duration 0.7s) to feel cinematic.

sections: Hero: Full bleed soft image overlay (use water ripples) with Cormorant Garamond text.
Every Ripple Begins Somewhere: Text-heavy, editorial layout with beautiful typesetting.
Where Our Hearts Lead Us: Grid/List of 10 focus areas, utilizing high-end editorial bento layout or asymmetric list.
How We Walk Alongside: Highlight Restore / Rise / Ripple initiatives.
Become Part of the Journey: Teaser for the volunteer journey.
The Ripple Promise: Ends quietly, no CTA. A reverent, peaceful closing moment.

volunteer_journey.ux: Multi-step onboarding. ~3 min completion. Progress bar showing steps with dots. Celebratory success screen.

focus_areas.structure: Our Heart / How We Walk Alongside / Join This Journey

ripples.layout: Categorized story cards, editorial magazine layout with beautiful typography.

people_behind_the_ripple.layout: Team roster categorized: Founders, Trustees, Advisors, Ripple Makers, Rise Fellows, Restore Circle Partners, Community Partners.

admin.layout: Simple, password-protected admin panel to view volunteer and contact submissions.
